scope: Native read-only MLflow inventory and author metadata review of empty Default; not backup, recovery or PostgreSQL migration

issues: Artifact locations outside managed local artifacts require explicit coverage

author_tests.warning: SQLAlchemy noload deprecation during MLflow fixture setup

default_review.name: Default
default_review.inspection: Author used the earlier inventory rows and separately inspected local directory metadata; no atomic cross-report snapshot asserted
default_review.decision: Preserve the Default metadata row and historical artifact_location; no existing payload at this path was observed to include. Do not ignore future Default contents automatically.

review_result: Inventory and Default coverage review completed for the author-reported scope. Raw inventory status remains review_required and is not rewritten. This is not restoration or model loading evidence.
evidence_basis: Author supplied printed pytest output, inventory summary and Default inspection JSON. Assistant did not access native report, database, artifacts or file bytes; paths are references and no receipt hashes were reconstructed.

next_increment_proposal.scope: Offline coordinated backup preparation of existing MLflow metadata plus all managed artifacts, followed by isolated verification/restoration before transfer or PostgreSQL cutover
next_increment_proposal.unit: All metadata tables in one consistent SQLite snapshot plus complete artifacts and provenance/URI coverage; Default metadata preserved even when its artifact path is absent
next_increment_proposal.budget_reason: 627 artifacts alone exceed existing 512-file dataset/study profiles; use a dedicated tracking profile rather than split the logical recovery unit. Retain the 256 MiB byte cap subject to measuring normalized DB and metadata; do not infer full payload size or raise automatically.
requirements: Pause MLflow UI/training/evaluation writers; snapshot and artifacts must represent the same quiescent state
Recheck all paths and external-location coverage, including Default, at preparation time
Verify SQLite integrity, foreign keys, full table contents and artifact file hashes; compare with archived inventory/provenance
Measure database and payload bytes before staging; refuse mutation, unknown external payload or exceeded budget without changing source
Original rows, IDs, historical URIs and scientific receipts remain untouched; any path adaptation belongs only to disposable verification copies
No refit, model promotion, new holdout evaluation, new server provisioning or automatic cleanup

limits: Inventory is not a coordinated backup or recovery proof
Managed artifact locations were reported present; this does not prove model reload/inference
Default absence is a time-specific observation, not a permanent coverage exception
Local inventory does not provide an independent off-machine disaster recovery copy
